event.text: Looking for AML Software tenders published 2–16 Nov (29,257 open bids in that window; 5 look relevant from their titles).
Shortlist: 26 bids from 62 titles looked at (closing soonest first). Reading documents…

bid.title: Hiring of Agency for IT Projects- Milestone basis
bid.buyer: Ministry of Finance / Department of Financial Services
bid.reason: The tender is for general IT project support and license renewal, not AML software.

evidence.quote: Scope of Work: Renewal of IBM MQ Advanced PVU Based licenses and on-call onsite ATS Support Resources Needed
The selected bidder shall provide a contingent of well-trained personnel and extend necessary mentoring and operational support to the intermediary network of agents

key_facts.scope_summary: Renewal of IBM MQ licenses and on-call onsite ATS support resources.

bid.title: Hiring of Agency for IT Projects- Milestone basis
bid.buyer: Ministry of Finance / Department of Financial Services
bid.reason: The tender is exclusively for an MSME Digital Lending Platform focused on loan processing and customer onboarding, with no scope for Anti-Money Laundering (AML) transaction monitoring or sanctions screening software.

evidence.quote: The Bank intends to procure, implement, integrate, manage, and maintain an end-to-end MSME Digital Lending Platform to enable Straight Through Processing (STP) & Assisted Lending Journeys etc. for 3 Years for MSME customers.

The solution shall support customer acquisition, digital onboarding, eligibility assessment, pre-qualified offer generation, credit decisioning, sanction, documentation, loan account creation, disbursement, servicing, and loan lifecycle management through a seamless omni-channel experience.

Integration & Support Central Know Your Customer Registry (CKYC). Integration & Support DigiLocker integration. Integration & Support Aadhaar Offline XML. Integration & Support Electronic Signature (e-Sign). Integration & Support Video Know Your Customer (Video KYC).

key_facts.scope_summary: End-to-end MSME Digital Lending Platform for STP and assisted lending journeys, including customer onboarding, eligibility assessment, and loan lifecycle management.

bid.title: Hiring of Agency for IT Projects- Milestone basis
bid.buyer: Ministry of Finance / Department of Financial Services
bid.reason: The tender explicitly requests an 'Enterprise KYC, KYB, CKYC & AML Solution' that includes 'AML/CFT compliance, screening and transaction monitoring', directly matching the AML software topic.

evidence.quote: NABARD seeks an Enterprise KYC, KYB, CKYC & AML Solution for development, implementation, integration and roll-out across NABARD applications and systems.

The Solution shall provide complete end-to-end capabilities for Individual KYC, Entity KYB, CKYC registry integration and lifecycle management, and AML/CFT compliance, screening and transaction monitoring.

The Bidder shall provide AML/CFT controls to support ongoing due diligence through screening, monitoring, alerting, investigation workflow, and audit-ready outputs aligned with applicable regulatory directions

key_facts.scope_summary: Development and implementation of an integrated Enterprise KYC, KYB, CKYC, and AML solution including transaction monitoring and sanctions screening for NABARD.

bid.title: Hiring of Agency for IT Projects- Milestone basis
bid.buyer: Ministry of Finance / Department of Financial Services
bid.reason: The tender is explicitly for an IT Asset Management (ITAM) solution, not Anti-Money Laundering software, as confirmed by the scope description and the specific exclusion of AML-related functions.

evidence.quote: Bank reserves the right to modify the scope due to change in regulatory instructions, market scenario and internal requirement within the overall objective of implementation of IT Asset Management Solution.
The Broad Scope of work and Technical requirements shall include but not be limited as mentioned in Annexure-8. Bidder has to conform compliance to the Scope of Work as mentioned in Annexure-8.
The selected bidder shall ensure that the Solution provided [Hardware/Software/licenses/services etc.] meets all the technical and functional requirements as envisaged in the scope of the RFP.

key_facts.scope_summary: Hiring of agency for IT Asset Management (ITAM) projects on a milestone basis.

bid.title: Hiring of Agency for IT Projects- Milestone basis

evidence.quote: Request for Proposal for End-to-End Procurement, Implementation, Management and Support of Comprehensive Financial Risk and Compliance Solutions
Minimum 1 year in AML, EFRM, Fraud Risk Management, transaction monitoring or financial crime solutions. KYC, CDD, EDD, transaction monitoring, STR/CTR, PMLA and FIU-IND reporting.
Minimum 3 years in AML/EFRM/Fraud Risk Management/financial crime solutions Transaction monitoring, AML scenarios, KYC, STR/CTR, FIU-IND reporting

key_facts.scope_summary: End-to-end procurement, implementation, management, and support of Comprehensive Financial Risk and Compliance Solutions software including AML, KYC, and transaction monitoring.

bid.title: Hiring of Agency for IT Projects- Milestone basis
bid.buyer: Ministry of Finance / Department of Financial Services
bid.reason: The tender is explicitly for an AI-powered Extended Detection and Response (XDR) cybersecurity solution, not AML software, although the bank's existing environment includes an AML solution.

evidence.quote: RFP - 70/2026-27 for Supply, Installation, Configuration, Integration and Maintenance of AI-powered Enterprise Extended Detection and Response (XDR) solution for a period of five (5) years

Bank invites proposals from eligible bidders to Supply, Installation, Configuration, Integration of AI-powered Enterprise Extended Detection and response (XDR) solution for five years, that will provide centralized visibility, advanced threat detection, automated response and integrated security operations

The proposed solution should provide enterprise-wide cyber threat detection and response covering endpoints, servers, network, and cloud. The proposed solution must be a unified XDR platform capable of delivering cross-domain threat detection, incident response, and continuous Threat exposure/Vulnerability Management

key_facts.scope_summary: Supply, installation, configuration, integration, and maintenance of an AI-powered Enterprise Extended Detection and Response (XDR) solution for endpoints, servers, network, and cloud.
